threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver shouts 'next stop' like it’s a game show, while locals jump off at random without a thought.
Caught a night bus in Brixton, and a guy was arguing with a post about the Tube strikes like it was a person. Even the bus driver was nodding in agreement.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using an old bike as a makeshift table for their chess game outside a Späti. That’s just Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here do you find a Kebab shop that doubles as a gallery. Past the döner counter, art hangs on the walls, and locals gather to discuss both.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they nonchalantly navigate BART delays while the newcomers panic. We've all learned to expect the unexpected here.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that had to stop for a guy selling fresh flowers on the corner. Only in San Francisco do we turn transit delays into mini markets.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Gràcia' is just for the parks and squares, but the real charm is in the back streets where the old shops sell things no one else does.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their struggle to find a place that serves proper fricandó—it’s like a rite of passage here.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the Overground' when taking that shiny orange train to Hackney Central. Been there, mate.
Caught a guy singing opera on the 59 last night. Deadpan faces all around, but he carried on like he was in Covent Garden. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew it when the scent of grilled kebabs mixed with the sound of street musicians on the corner. It felt like a real community moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a bar with an indoor swimming pool where locals sip cocktails while lounging on inflatable unicorns. It's bizarrely perfect.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a real local knows to carry a backup phone charger when waiting for a delayed Muni. It’s as essential as a burrito on a Friday night.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full suit pull out a saxophone during a delay at Civic Center, and it somehow matched the mood of the smoke-filled chaos perfectly.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to Park Güell, but they miss the quiet charm of Plaça del Sol – where locals sip café amb llet and gossip among the trees.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to embrace the midday siesta; they're still buzzing around noon like it’s rush hour.
